paragraphs.text: Esbo is a soldier of Femeref on the continent of Jamuraa , on the plane of Dominaria .

Esbo stands as a sentinel of authority at the entrance of the magistrate's estate. As a guard, his presence is both commanding and respectful. His physique is robust and solid, embodying strength and vigilance. Dressed in standard but meticulously maintained armor, his attire signifies his role in safeguarding the magistrate and the city. Esbo is known for his sense of duty and adherence to orders, but his demeanor also reveals a hint of curiosity and concern, especially when faced with Niambi ’s impassioned plea. His facial features are persistent, yet not unyielding, reflecting an internal struggle between duty and empathy.

Esbo was stationed at the entrance of the magistrate Sidar Teshunda ’s villa in Femeref , tasked with maintaining security and enforcing the orders of the day. During this period, Niambi sought entry into the magistrate’s residence to plead her case about the Efravan caravan. Despite Esbo's initial resistance due to heightened security concerns and the magistrate's standing orders, Niambi used her diplomatic skills and mystical persuasion to appeal directly to him. She recounted a symbolic dream that positioned Esbo as the central figure — illustrating the urgency and significance of her mission. Moved by her words and the warmth of her magic, Esbo allowed Niambi entry into the estate.
